description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeSalaryDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup methods, test cases for saving, deleting, and retrieving employee salary data, and references to multiple project-specific classes and entities.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeSalaryDao functionalities within the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of EmployeeSalaryDao and populating test data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeSalary entity without direct debit.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalaryWithEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeSalary with an associated EmpDirectDebit.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Tests deletion of specific EmployeeSalary records.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalariesBulk
methods.description: Tests bulk deletion of EmployeeSalary records.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific EmployeeSalary by employee and salary IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of EmployeeSalaries based on filter parameters.

methods.description: Tests counting EmployeeSalaries based on filter parameters.
